DAG layout

dag_layout.Rd

How the Workflow extension arranges the board: the layered DAG layout, its flow direction and its spacing. Users change both from the toolbar's layout menu; new_dag_extension() takes the one a board starts with.

Usage

dag_layout(
  direction = c("TB", "LR"),
  spacing = c("normal", "compact", "loose")
)

is_dag_layout(x)

Arguments

direction

"TB" (top to bottom) or "LR" (left to right). A wide board turned sideways grows in height instead.

spacing

"compact", "normal" or "loose": the gaps between blocks and between layers.

x

Object to test.

Value

dag_layout() returns an object of class dag_layout: a list of direction and spacing, plain values only, so it round-trips through serialization.

Examples

dag_layout()
#> $direction
#> [1] "TB"
#> 
#> $spacing
#> [1] "normal"
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "dag_layout"
dag_layout(direction = "LR", spacing = "compact")
#> $direction
#> [1] "LR"
#> 
#> $spacing
#> [1] "compact"
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "dag_layout"
